result.summary: The image shows a wide urban street with continuous sidewalks on both sides but no marked pedestrian crossings or traffic calming measures. The lack of a buffer between the walkway and the travel lanes on the residential side increases the exposure of pedestrians to moving vehicles.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The wide roadway lacks marked crossings, increasing the risk for pedestrians crossing mid-block.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the center of the roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk on the right is immediately adjacent to the roadway, providing no separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks to provide designated crossing points and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add curb extensions at intersections or mid-block to shorten the crossing distance and slow traffic.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Plant street trees to create a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the road.

result.summary: The image shows a residential mid-block environment with row houses directly fronting a narrow sidewalk. The pedestrian path is partially obstructed by a sign post and lacks any physical buffer from the adjacent roadway.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A sign post is located in the middle of the sidewalk, reducing the clear walking width.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk is directly adjacent to the roadway with no physical separation or buffer zone.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the entire visible curb line

hazards.name: Uneven Pavement
hazards.description: The sidewalk surface is cracked and has uneven patches.

interventions.title: Signage Consolidation
interventions.description: Relocate the sign post to the curb edge to clear the pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Green Buffer Strip
interventions.description: Install a planting strip or street trees between the sidewalk and the road to provide physical separation.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair and level the sidewalk surface to ensure a continuous, hazard-free walking environment.

result.summary: The street provides continuous sidewalks on both sides with mature trees offering a buffer from traffic on the left. However, the wide roadway and lack of marked crossings or traffic calming measures may encourage higher vehicle speeds, creating a less protected environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Wide Roadway
hazards.description: The width of the travel lanes and the lack of physical narrowing may encourage vehicle speeds that exceed safe urban limits.

hazards.name: Lack of Mid-block Crossing
hazards.description: There are no marked crossing points visible along this stretch, which may lead to unsafe mid-block crossings by pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with high-visibility patterns to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions at potential crossing points to reduce crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Speed Tables
interventions.description: Implement speed tables or other vertical traffic calming measures to reduce vehicle speeds in this mixed-use area.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment consists of a two-lane roadway with wide shoulders and sidewalks on both sides, but lacks any marked crossings or traffic control devices. The institutional nature of the adjacent buildings suggests a high potential for pedestrian activity that is currently unmanaged by the street design.

hazards.name: Unmarked mid-block crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians likely need to cross between these institutional buildings, but no marked crossing or signage is provided.

hazards.name: Wide travel lanes
hazards.description: The width of the lanes and shoulders may encourage higher vehicle speeds in an area with institutional frontage.
